notes: Cool-season leafy green. Keep EC low; high EC causes tip burn. pH 5.5-6.2.
Hardy brassica. Tolerates higher EC than lettuce. Thai: คะน้า.
Fast brassica. Thai: ผักกวางตุ้ง/กวางตุ้ง.
Warm-season, very fast. Thai: ผักบุ้ง (water spinach).
Fruiting crop needs high EC. Raise EC through fruiting for flavour.
Warm-season herb. Thai: โหระพา/กะเพรา family.
